name: Dummy Echo
description: A reference plugin used to exercise the plugin machinery (Phase 1, #1517): its sidecar starts, is reachable only from granted agents' networks, and disappears on uninstall. It brokers nothing real — the CLI echoes its arguments back so the registry, sidecar lifecycle and grant-driven network wiring can be verified end to end before a real broker (Phase 3) exists.
promptLine: You can echo through the dummy broker with `aee-echo` — run `aee-echo --help`.
